items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Joe Rulo, who was the other cornet player in the band... he gave me a lot of his time.

ctx.x: Yeah but not good enough. And, so, Joe Rulo, who was the other cornet player in the band, said - look - if you want to really do yourself a favor -

now - he said, if you will let me--- when we're not busy doing what we have to do and you want to come in there -- in the locker room with me, I'll show you a quick way to read. And, he gave me a lot of his time.
